name: Chabin Han
source:
"I wrote you a letter every time I hit a home run. Though... I never gave you a single one."

Baseball team ace.

A childhood friend who grew up in the same neighborhood as the protagonist. He started playing baseball because he wanted to be with her and become stronger. After entering high school, they drifted apart for a while due to baseball team issues, but just when he thought they had reconciled and could spend joyful times together like before... Why did this "incident" happen to us?
